idea-plugin.name: Teal
idea-plugin.description:
Teal (.tl) support for IntelliJ IDEA: syntax highlighting, inline diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, and Find Usages (same-document).

A thin companion plugin — nearly all language intelligence is delegated to LSP4IJ wrapping teal-language-server, which must be installed separately (luarocks install teal-language-server). The one exception is Find Usages: teal-language-server doesn't implement textDocument/references, so the plugin answers it itself by probing the server's own go-to-definition on each candidate identifier. Syntax highlighting reuses vscode-teal's MIT-licensed TextMate grammar.

server.name: Teal Language Server
server.description: Wraps teal-language-server to provide diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, and Find Usages for Teal (.tl) files.
